utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, 10 AM at the community center works for me. I’ll double-check the route and bring anything small we might still need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Pia. I’ll bring my gloves and meet you at the community center at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, thanks Eli. I’ll make sure the route is sorted and I’ll see you at the community center at 10.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what still needs fixing for the repair drive? I can help with the bigger stuff and head over around 6 if that works.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That works, thanks — the bigger stuff would be a big help, and 6 is fine. I’ve still got you down for the wrench and spare screws, so if you can bring any tape too, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I can bring tape too, and I’ll be there around 6 to help with the bigger repairs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. If you could start with the boxes by the curb, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’ll start with the boxes by the curb. Anything in particular I should look for, or just sort through them?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just sort through them and set aside anything broken or missing parts. I’ll come by and check the rest in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — I really appreciate you asking around. If you hear anything about the time or meeting spot too, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the time and meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — that really helps. I’ll keep an ear out too, and let me know if you find those supplies.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Oren — I’ll send you the details as soon as I have them, and I really appreciate you helping out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Jules—just send me the details when you can, and I’ll keep an eye out for your message.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’m checking on the repair drive details now and I’ll pass them along as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Quinn. Send me the list and I’ll see what I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the list right over and spread the word to anyone who can help. We’re still looking for extra tools, gloves, and a few hands for the bigger fixes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, I’ll start rounding up the tools and gloves. If you still need extra hands, I can ask a couple neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me what kind of repairs we’re focusing on for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard we’re mainly gathering common fix-it supplies—screwdrivers, screws, and old extension cords. If there’s a different repair need, tell me and I’ll keep an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — that helps. Can you remind me of the time and meeting spot for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—what do you need a hand with?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, it’s still happening. I’ll check the pickup time and drop-off place and get right back to you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand and bring a few tools—just let me know what still needs fixing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Gus — I’ll spread the word and let folks know you’re bringing tools. I’ll check what still needs fixing for the repair drive and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Vik—thanks. Just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — just let me know the time when you’ve got it, and I’ll work around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye — I’m checking the timing now and I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll keep my schedule flexible around drop-off and pickup, and I’m happy to help once you have the time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s moved to Sunday now, and it’ll be at the community center at 10 AM. If I hear anything else, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — Sunday at 10 AM at the community center works for me. I’ll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks for helping spread the word! If I hear any new details about volunteers or tools, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m organizing what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—just send me the list of supplies you still need, and I’ll keep an eye on it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send over the supply list today, and I really appreciate you keeping an eye on it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard folks were organizing a repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Nell — we could use help sorting the items that need fixing and handing them off to the right people.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can help sort the items and pass them along. Just let me know where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details—can you confirm the time and where we should meet for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still waiting on the final details too, but I can help spread the word as soon as they’re confirmed. Once I know the time and meetup spot, I’ll pass it along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’ll wait for the final time and meetup spot too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that we still need repair supplies and remind folks to check in when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Vik — if you hear of anyone bringing supplies, please send them my way so I can track what’s on hand. I’ll keep updating you if anything changes at the drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll let you know if anyone says they’re bringing supplies. Thanks, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — what’s still needed for the repair drive? I can keep an eye out for screws, screwdrivers, or old extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — screws, screwdrivers, and old extension cords would help a lot. If you can keep an eye out for those, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll keep an eye out for those and bring whatever I find.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Ira — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m lining up the last few volunteers and tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. Let me know if you still need any screwdrivers, screws, or old extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Ira — a screwdriver and any spare screws would be really helpful, and old extension cords would be great too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still set for 10 AM at the community center, and they could use volunteers plus a wrench, tape, and spare screws. If I hear any other updates, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — 10 AM works with school drop-off, so I can help out. I’ll bring what I can and keep an eye out for any specific repair needs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s great, Faye — I’ll let you know if I hear any more specific repair needs. Thanks for pitching in!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—what tools do you still need, and how many extra hands are we talking?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: A screwdriver set and some zip ties would help most, and maybe two extra hands if you can find them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can probably round up a screwdriver set and zip ties. I’ll see if I can find two people to help, too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, it’s still on for 10 AM at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, 10 AM at the community center still works for me. I’ll bring gloves, a wrench, tape, and any spare screws I can find.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm. See you at 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll send you the pickup time and drop-off place as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — please do, and I’ll watch for the details so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I’ll pass them along as soon as I get the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We still need a few basics for the repair drive—tools, gloves, and anyone handy with small fixes. If you can swing by, I’ll get you the details and make sure you’re on the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — I can bring some tools and gloves, and I’m handy with the bigger fixes. What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — come by at 9 AM and I’ll put you right on the list. I’ll send you the full details once I’ve got the final setup.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Gus—bring the tools by and I’ll count them in. If you’ve got any nails, screws, or spare hardware, those would help too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll bring the tools and check my stash for nails, screws, and any spare hardware too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Gus—I'll keep a tally and make sure it all gets counted in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I can bring the screwdriver set and some zip ties for the repair drive. Just let me know if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — we may also need tape and a flashlight. I'll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — tape and a flashlight, got it. Just let me know if there’s anything else I should grab for the repair drive.
